title: AI-Portfolio
tagline: An AI-powered interactive portfolio website with 3D animations and a built-in intelligent assistant.
description: Personal AI-powered portfolio website with interactive 3D elements and intelligent features.
longDescription: A cutting-edge portfolio website built with React, Three.js, and AI integration. Features a 150-frame scroll-driven hero animation, 3D avatar tilt effects, orbital skill cards, infinite-scroll project showcase, a 3D scene with floating shapes and particle system, and a fully client-side AI chat assistant with 16 pattern categories.
problemStatement: Traditional portfolios are static and passive — they display information but don't engage visitors. I wanted to create an immersive, interactive experience that showcases technical skills while providing an intelligent assistant that can answer questions about my work in real-time, all without relying on external APIs.
keyFeatures: 150-frame scroll-driven hero animation with GSAP ScrollTrigger
AI chat assistant with client-side NLP engine (16 pattern categories)
3D avatar tilt pop-out effect with SVG ring animation
Orbital skill cards with GSAP hover rings and 3D tilt
Infinite auto-scrolling project carousel with pause-on-hover
Custom 3D contact card with floating concentric circles
Physical certificate card design with PDF embed and multi-image preview
Command palette (Ctrl+K) with substring search
Dark/Light theme with 22 remapped CSS variables
Custom dual-layer cursor with hover detection
Buttery smooth scrolling via Lenis
Page loader with animated progress ring and percentage counter
Scroll progress bar fixed at viewport top
Magnetic button effects with cursor-following pull
3D scene with floating shapes, torus ring, and 200-particle system
Reduced motion support via prefers-reduced-motion media query
Skip-to-content accessibility link for keyboard navigation
Code splitting and lazy loading for all sections
Fully responsive across all device sizes
myRole: Full-Stack Developer & Designer — conceived the architecture, designed the UI/UX, implemented all 9 sections, built the AI chat engine, created the custom animation systems, and handled deployment to GitHub Pages.

challengesAndSolutions.challenge: Loading and synchronizing 150 individual PNG frames for the hero animation without jank
challengesAndSolutions.solution: Implemented a preloading system that tracks each frame's load status, displays a real-time SVG progress ring, and only activates GSAP ScrollTrigger after all frames are ready.

challengesAndSolutions.challenge: Combining GSAP and Framer Motion in the same project without conflicts
challengesAndSolutions.solution: Used each library for its strengths — GSAP for scroll-driven/timeline animations (ScrollTrigger, elastic easing) and Framer Motion for layout/viewport animations (AnimatePresence, whileInView).

challengesAndSolutions.challenge: Building an AI assistant without external API dependencies
challengesAndSolutions.solution: Created a weighted keyword matching engine with 16 pattern categories, fallback chains, and contextual responses — all running entirely client-side.

challengesAndSolutions.challenge: Achieving seamless infinite horizontal scroll for projects and certifications
challengesAndSolutions.solution: Used a tripled-array technique with requestAnimationFrame for continuous 0.8px/frame scrolling, position tracking via DOMMatrixReadOnly, and automatic reset when reaching one full set.

challengesAndSolutions.challenge: Creating a complete dark/light theme system that affects 22 CSS variables
challengesAndSolutions.solution: Built a CSS variable remapping system with a `.light` class overlay, localStorage persistence, and theme-aware components that dynamically adapt all colors.

resultsAndImpact: Features 6 complete project case studies with video demos
Displays 14 professional certifications with image previews
Accommodates 6 career experience entries with scroll-driven timeline
Built-in AI assistant answers visitor queries instantly with 16 pattern categories
Lighthouse score optimized with code splitting and lazy loading
Fully accessible with reduced-motion support, skip-to-content link, and keyboard navigation
SEO-optimized with JSON-LD, Open Graph, and Twitter Cards
architecture: Component-based architecture with data-driven JSON content files. 9 lazy-loaded sections (Hero, About, Skills, Projects, Services, Experience, Education, Certifications, Contact) + global components (Navigation, Loader, Scroll Progress, AI Assistant, Command Palette, Custom Cursor, Magnetic Button, Noise Overlay). Custom hooks for theme, scroll, parallax, text reveal, and accessibility. Three.js scene with floating shapes and particle system. GSAP + Framer Motion for animations. Tailwind CSS for styling with custom CSS variables. React Router for client-side routing.

title: AI-WildEye
tagline: AI-driven early-warning system for detecting human-wildlife conflicts in real-time.
description: Web-Based Wild Animal Detection and Alert System - College Main Project.
longDescription: An AI-driven early-warning system designed to detect potential human-wildlife conflicts and issue smart alerts, demonstrating core software intelligence ahead of future hardware integration.
problemStatement: Human-wildlife conflicts cause significant harm to both communities and animals. Existing detection systems rely on expensive hardware and are not accessible to rural communities.
keyFeatures: Real-time animal detection
Smart alert system
Web-based dashboard
myRole: Full-Stack Developer — built the ML detection model, Flask API, and React frontend.

challengesAndSolutions.challenge: Detecting animals in varied lighting conditions
challengesAndSolutions.solution: Applied data augmentation and transfer learning to improve model robustness.

resultsAndImpact: College main project with highest grade
Successfully detected 5+ animal species in real-time
architecture: React frontend → Flask API → TensorFlow model → OpenCV video processing pipeline.

keyFeatures: Secure authentication
Digital proof uploads
Automated PDF generation

title: AI-BrestCancer & Insurance Predictor
tagline: ML-powered breast cancer classification and insurance purchase prediction system.
description: ML-based breast cancer classification and insurance purchase prediction.
longDescription: Insurance Purchase Prediction using Machine Learning. Predicted customer insurance purchases using KNN, SVM, Random Forest and Logistic Regression. Breast Cancer Histology Image Classification using CNN-based deep learning model for benign and malignant image classification.
problemStatement: Early detection of breast cancer and prediction of insurance purchasing behavior can significantly improve healthcare outcomes and business decision-making.
keyFeatures: CNN-based image classification
Multiple ML model comparison
Real-time prediction API
myRole: ML Engineer — developed both prediction models and deployed the Flask API.

challengesAndSolutions.challenge: Achieving high accuracy on imbalanced medical data
challengesAndSolutions.solution: Applied SMOTE oversampling and compared 4 different algorithms to select the best performer.

resultsAndImpact: Compared 4 ML algorithms for insurance prediction
architecture: TensorFlow CNN model + Scikit-learn classifiers → Flask REST API → Web frontend.
